title:
"Unavailable Max Plan Upgrade Option for Existing API User"

This title captures the key technical issue:
- Specifies the specific problem (Max plan upgrade not visible)
- Hints at potential account/user history complication
- Uses technical language appro
body:

**Environment Info**
- Platform: macos
- Terminal: Apple_Terminal
- Version: 0.2.64
- Feedback ID: d373f8fa-81a3-45cd-87d4-f6b3ba390f24
